ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.65:0.35 ratio of low-intensity dark pixels to high-intensity white pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions occupy the outer lateral zones of both lobes. The left lobe contains a large white field with dark speckling at the inferior margin. The right lobe exhibits a horizontal white band along the superior edge with dense, vertical dark mottling covering the remainder.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with an estimated angle of 125 degrees and a bounding box depth roughly 12% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary, with prominent irregular indentations visible on the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature from the median notch to the distal tips, following a smooth parabolic arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparsely distributed small white circular pixel clusters visible within the dark central pigment field and on the dark mottling of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single vertical dark linear mark on the far-left white patch; multiple faint, horizontal white linear marks near the lower central junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of 4-5 parallel vertical white linear scars (rake marks) are visible in the lower central dark pigment region near the peduncle junction.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical dark pigment 'dripping' pattern on the right lobe extending from the trailing edge toward the superior margin.
